SuccessEnvelope.description: Universal Response Envelope — all API responses use this structure. See spec/response-envelope/README.md.

Results.description: Always an array. Length 1 for single items, 0+ for lists.

Navigation.description: Pagination links. Omitted for single items and errors.

Errors.description: Present when HasAnyErrors is true and error reporting is enabled.

MethodsStack.description: Present when debug/traversal mode is enabled.

EnvelopeStatus.description: Describes the outcome of the request.

EnvelopeAttributes.description: Describes the shape and size of the result set, plus endpoint tracking.

RequestedAt.description: The Go API endpoint that handled the request.

RequestDelegatedAt.description: The downstream endpoint (e.g., PHP/WordPress) the request was proxied to. Empty if not delegated.

EnvelopeNavigation.description: Pagination URL links for list responses. Omitted for single items. Uses pointer with omitempty in Go.

NextPage.description: URL for the next page. Null if on last page.

PrevPage.description: URL for the previous page. Null if on first page.

CloserLinks.description: Sliding window of nearby page URLs.

EnvelopeErrors.description: Error information. Top-level, conditionally included when HasAnyErrors is true and error reporting is enabled. Uses pointer with omitempty in Go.

BackendMessage.description: Primary error message from the Go backend.

DelegatedServiceErrorStack.description: Stack trace lines from downstream PHP/other services. Only included when includeStackTrace is enabled.
example: PHP Fatal error: Class 'PDO' not found in plugin.php:42

Backend.description: Stack trace lines from the Go backend. Only included when includeStackTrace is enabled.

EnvelopeMethodsStack.description: Debug call-chain trace. Top-level, conditionally included when includeMethodsStack is enabled. Uses pointer with omitempty in Go.

Backend.description: Ordered list of method calls in the Go backend.

EnvelopeMethodFrame.description: A single frame in the methods stack.

responseDebug.description: Controls which optional envelope sections are included in API responses.

includeErrors.description: Include the Errors block when HasAnyErrors is true.

includeStackTrace.description: Include Backend and DelegatedServiceErrorStack in Errors.

includeMethodsStack.description: Include the MethodsStack block for call-chain tracing.

maxStackFrames.description: Max stack trace lines to include.

RemotePluginActionResult.description: Result of a remote plugin lifecycle action (enable/disable/delete).

RemotePluginInfo.description: Remote plugin information from the companion uploader.

RemoteFileInfo.description: File metadata from a remote plugin.

GitStatusResult.description: Git status for a plugin repository.

E2ETestResult.description: Result for an individual test case within a run.

BootstrapResult.description: Result of deploying the companion uploader plugin.

PublishPreview.description: Preview of files that will be published.
